items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Marshall Royal told me their names, the names of the Italian brothers who had it.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, yes, it was larger than this one, and that's where the Alabam was. You see, after the Apex closed there, then these Italians took it over and named it the Alabam.

Oh, I see, that's how the -- Marshall Royal told me their names, the names of the Italian brothers who had it. I can't remember what their names were. But -- so they -- he didn't seem to know whether they were involved at the same time Moseby was or not, but --
